$comment: The render context for templates/kitty/kitty.conf.j2. One name: the runtime-owned current/ pointer directory, embedded ABSOLUTE because kitty resolves `include` relative to the config file. An empty render is a kitty that never re-themes — silently.
title: kitty/kitty.conf.j2 — render context
description: The single value the kitty config reads: the runtime state-root current/ directory holding colors.kitty.

kitty_config_state_current_dir.description: Absolute path to the runtime-owned current/ pointer directory. The template emits `include <value>/colors.kitty`; kitty joins a relative include under its config dir, so a non-absolute value silently includes nothing.

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback: the whole point of the absolute include is that a missing value fails the render instead of shipping a config that includes nothing.
x-render-contract.name_shape: The name is the consumer's own variable name, not a generic one — the template moved verbatim, so its contract keeps the identifier the consumer already supplies.
